question: Will a new Israeli government win a Knesset confidence vote by December 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if the Knesset passes a vote of confidence in a new government and it is constituted by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM US Eastern. A failed vote or the caretaker government continuing does not count.

reference_class.description: Israeli elections since 2013 where a government won a confidence vote within 65 days of election day

history.rationale: 10/27/2026 update to the market price 49.5%. No independent news view.
